title: Personal fitness coach

title: Inconsistent!
body:
Many issues. 1. Does not allow third party gadgets/softwares as data source for calories, exercise minutes 2. Intermittently works with third party softwares such as strava. (I.e. 1 day my exercise minutes in strava was counted in fitness, the next day it didn’t count my workout) I expected better from an apple app. This app needs significant improvement! 3. Previously used a garmin watch integrated to my phone, calories count works fine but when i paired an apple watch, fitness just went crazy. It disregared other data from third party apps/devices. 4. Yesterday, when i didn’t wear my apple watch, my phone did not record any activity/fitness info, when it clearly indicated that the iphone can work alone to gather data!

Everyday, new problems discovered!
